`interface IBorrowedTextureBackend`<br/>
**Extends:** [`ISnapshotBackend`](/reference/testing/isnapshotbackend/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`GlBorrowedTextureBackend`](/reference/base-opengl/glborrowedtexturebackend/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.contract` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [IBorrowedTextureBackend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/contract/IBorrowedTextureBackend.java)

A snapshot backend that can create, lend and inspect a texture of its host, for the borrowed texture suite.

- [The suites](/build/testing-a-backend/#the-suites)

## Method details

<a id="IBorrowedTextureBackend-method-borrow"></a>

### borrow

`ITexture borrow(Supplier<Object> texture)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the borrowed texture of your backend over that supplier of host handles.

<a id="IBorrowedTextureBackend-method-isBorrowableTexture"></a>

### isBorrowableTexture

`boolean isBorrowableTexture(Object texture)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

If `true`, the object is a handle of a texture of the host that `borrow` accepts.

<a id="IBorrowedTextureBackend-method-createBorrowableTexture"></a>

### createBorrowableTexture

`Object createBorrowableTexture(int width, int height, int color, boolean mipmapped)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Creates a texture of the host of that size, filled with that ARGB color, with mipmaps when the boolean is `true`, and returns its handle.

<a id="IBorrowedTextureBackend-method-readBorrowableParameters"></a>

### readBorrowableParameters

`Map<String,String> readBorrowableParameters(Object texture)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the sampling parameters of the texture of the host by name, such as its filter and its wrap, to compare before and after a frame.
